model: population prior + grounded athlete history + comparable recent responses + current context → ordinal option preference
requiredEvidence: same task/equipment/role and relevant environment comparability
known observation chronology when recency is claimed
actual response distinct from predicted response
allowedChanges: soft preference among independently admissible same-dose configurations
choice of familiar progression/regression under envelope
prohibited: new hard causal rule from one or confounded observations
clearance/restored capacity from ordinary function alone
hysteresis: Retain population prior under noisy or mixed evidence; consistent comparable observations can support a reversible soft preference. Contradiction or context change weakens it; no irreversible global athlete rule.
updateSemantics: Pure proposal/snapshot only. No persistent real athlete model, production ingestion or official plan mutation.
implementationLimits: Executable behavior and accepted model schema must be read from final r4 runtime/tests; conceptual desired fields do not imply all are implemented.
